title: Wub Doctrine
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: Thick square-wave wubs grind against a halftime 909 kit — massive snares on beat 3, rhythmic LFO gates chopping through two aggressive peaks with a skeletal valley between them. Playful menace builds from a filtered intro through relentless bass-led drops, collapsing into a stripped outro.
